**Merged to main.** Pull request 85 merged the release-readiness line on 2026-11-13 (developer surfaces gated out of release builds, menu UI rebuilt, startup payload 4.13 MB to 2.10 MB, offline cache 14.77 MB to 6.74 MB, new code-budget, determinism and architecture gates).
